integrity: Full finite examples are replayable with checker.py; general assertion has a mathematical proof. Existing covering-array results and full disjunctive normal forms are cited as prior work, not new discoveries.
scientific_limitations: Only minimal number of classical flat outer disjuncts, over fixed variables and restricted team cardinality; not total formula length, nonflat formulas, or tensor disjunction. General higher-strength covering-array optima may be unknown. Novelty depends on completeness of literature search.
title: Bounded-team dependence resolutions are exactly binary covering arrays
